title: Also remove the old workflow copy and schema files when a teammate runs join?
context: The old workflow copy, its hash file, the .git/info/exclude line and the schemas folder live separately on each machine and are not shared through git. If only paqad-ai update cleans them up, every teammate who only runs join keeps them until they run update themselves. join already runs the old MCP-file cleanup, so adding this cleanup there is cheap. Grounded in docs/modules/cli-lifecycle/features/join/business.md.
